anomalies.impact: The two N-channel MOSFETs are placed in each other's positions (sourcing/placement mix-up). The valve still switches, but through the smaller SOT-23 device with roughly an order of magnitude higher Rds(on) and far less thermal/power margin than the intended DFN part.

anomalies.observed: R25, the pull-down resistor on the FLOAT_HIGH float-switch input in the "Water Level Sensor/Switches" block, is drawn as 1.0 kΩ (the companion pull-up R30 is 10 kΩ).
anomalies.expected: 10 kΩ. The specification quotes the reference netlist showing the high-level float pull-down as 10 kΩ: "R9 GND FLOAT_HIGH 10k".

anomalies.impact: Ten times the standing current is forced through the float reed switch and its wiring; the digitised logic level itself is unaffected, so the fault is easily missed in functional test.
